history.summary: A mixed-use / SOHO-style freehold development in D15 with effectively no appreciation data (1 URA transaction) and a 2BR asking 11% above the project's $1,564 median PSF. Thin data plus a non-standard, less-liquid building format make this a Neutral-to-cautious pass.
history.rating_rationale: URA appreciation is null on a single transaction — no reliable basis to project growth. Asking $1,736 PSF vs $1,564 median = +11% premium. E-Space is a small commercial/SOHO-flavoured project near Changi Road, an awkward, niche format that thins the resale pool. 930m to Kembangan is a soft walk. Freehold D15 is the only real positive; not enough to outweigh thin data and the premium.
catalysts: established lifestyle district with deep owner-occupier base
